title: Adam Hamilton (Kansas)
intro:
Adam Hamilton (Democratic Party) is running for election to the U.S. Senate to represent Kansas. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.
Hamilton completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
